description: Changing weather (rg::WeatherAuthority, core/include/rg/weather_authority.h): a semi-Markov chain over the sky.json weather presets. Each segment lasts a log-normal time with the state's mean_hours (game hours, spread duration_sigma, at least min_duration_game_s); the next preset is drawn from the season's next.<state> weights (the season is the UT month at the change); a candidate that is too warm or too cold at the change (climate.json temperature with that preset's cloud cover) is swapped for too_warm / too_cold. Changes blend over transition_game_s (sky cloud cover; precipitation and thunder switch halfway; the physics weather ramps over the same time). The chain is a pure function of seed, the start time and the start preset, so a server can run it and send rg.weather_broadcast/1 messages. All numbers [AS]: a plausible central-European pattern (more thunderstorms and hail in summer, snow only below freezing), not fitted to station data.
